text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I accompanied Sakura Chiyono O to 
an amusement park to test whether she had 
overcome her motion sickness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The train ride went smoothly...! The real 
challenge starts now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Please watch over the fruits of my 
hard work!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: First up... is the Ferris wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Creeeeak... Creeeeak...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa... I-It's so high up! Ah, but the 
view is beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was completely fine! That means all my 
training is paying off, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, next up is... the roller 
coaster!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack-clack, clack-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, we're dropping from this high 
up, droppi— Ah, aaaaah... Hyaaaaaah~!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Urgh... W-Well, that was... more fear 
than... motion sickness, so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No, then I won't have overcome it 
properly... Let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Next is the hardest challenge of all... 
The spinning teacups!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The teacups start to move. Spinning 
around, gradually increasing speed, 
faster, and faster, and faster—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whirl-whirl, whirl-whirl...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oof, urgh...! S-Stoppp...!! U-Uuuuuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... Thank you so much for lending me 
your shoulder...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm still... nowhere close to overcoming 
it. Like this, I still can't—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my. What are you two doing over there—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! What happened!? Chiyo-chan, 
you look completely pale...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!? M-Maruzen-san!? This is... um, 
I... well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hesitating for a moment, Sakura 
Chiyono O explained all the various things 
she had been trying to overcome her motion 
sickness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I showed you... such a pathetic side of me 
again. I'm so uncool, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all. Giving it your 
best effort is a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But... I want to become cool like you, 
Maruzen-san, yet at this rate...
choice_data_list: Results don't show up right away.
Are you going to give up on overcoming it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But... I want to become cool like you, 
Maruzen-san, yet at this rate...
choice_data_list: Results don't show up right away.
Are you going to give up on overcoming it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. No matter what it is, you 
build results step by step over time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Giving it maximum throttle is great and 
all, but rushing will only stall you out. 
Let's go at your own pace♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't make such a teary face. Oh 
dear, your hair and clothes are all 
disheveled.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come here, let me fix them up for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hawaa!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your hair is so fluffy. It really 
makes me want to pat your head.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! If you'd like, p-please do, as much 
as you want...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold still now. Your ribbon is crooked 
too... let me straighten it out.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There, all done.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much...! Even so, I've 
gone and caused trouble again—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Straighten your back. If you want to be 
cool, then act cool as many times as it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if you stumble, keep going until you 
become the person you want to be... okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes... YES!! I'll do my absolute 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O nodded repeatedly at 
Maruzensky's words. Though she hasn't 
overcome it yet, things will surely head 
in a good direction someday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard. Everyone has 
things they aren't good at.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. In the end, I just caused 
trouble for everyone...
choice_data_list: You're not a burden at all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ... I shouldn't sit around moping.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know! For a change of pace, how about we 
go shopping together sometime?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
With you, Maruzen-san...!? Ah, but I, 
um...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Window shopping while taking a relaxing 
stroll sounds fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to pick out some super trendy 
clothes that look great on you, 
Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! I would love to join you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep working hard... so that trendy 
clothes look good on me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she couldn't overcome her sickness, 
it seems Sakura Chiyono O won't stop 
striving towards her idol.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I don't want that!! Definitely, 
absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if I haven't fully overcome it, 
things have gotten better!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So... I want to try my best, at least 
within what I can handle...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the spirit. Let's do our best 
with what we can do, within our own 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Taking it step by step is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. It's just as you two say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see... I was just in such a rush, 
thinking I had to overcome it right away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, Maruzen-san wouldn't be able to 
invite me out for a drive, and...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Was that really the reason?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah! N-No, that's not what I meant 
just now...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so adooorable♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's alright. Big sis will wait for you as 
long as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely go for that drive 
someday. That's a promise between 
Chiyo-chan and me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes time... I'll give it my 
all to overcome this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, until then, let's go out using our 
own two legs. I'm sure that'll be lots of 
fun too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Color returns to Sakura Chiyono O's pale 
cheeks. The smiles on both horse girls' 
faces looked remarkably alike.
